competitors.name: NEOM Wellbeing
competitors.summary: Candidate competitor in premium home fragrance and wellbeing-oriented scent rituals; overlaps on candles, diffusers, gifting and wellness framing. This is a source-based category candidate, not a verified competitive-spend or ad-performance comparison.
evidence: NEOM Wellbeing | Luxury Natural Essential Oils, Diffusers & Candles
scientifically proven to help your daily wellbeing.
Here to help you with better sleep, less stress, a mood boost or more energy
competitors.evidenceCaveat: Scientific efficacy is NEOM’s own marketing claim, not independently verified in this test.

competitors.name: Rituals
competitors.summary: Candidate competitor in home fragrance, reed diffusers, candles, room sprays and gift-ready lifestyle presentation. Broader international lifestyle range; relevant as an adjacent aspirational benchmark, not necessarily a price-equivalent direct competitor.
evidence: After all, it's a hectic world out there and we believe home should always be a welcoming and restful place to be.
Rituals is an international brand offering unique luxury lifestyle products. Designed with taste and attention to detail, our ideas for your home combine fine ingredients with stylish presentation.
our reed diffusers are sleekly presented gift boxed with glass phial and wooden cuff.
competitors.evidenceCaveat: Positioning and product descriptions are brand-owned claims; ad volume, engagement, spend and conversions were not obtained.

competitors.name: Wax Lyrical

evidence: Wax Lyrical | Shop British Made Scented Candles & Home Fragrance
Transform any space with our Made in England fragrances. Ready to refresh your home and indulge your senses.
Proudly crafted in Cumbria. Bringing British home fragrance to life since 1980.
Pick any four in our '4 for 3' event and the cheapest one's on us. Mix and match reed diffusers, refills, candles, wax melts and tealights.
competitors.evidenceCaveat: UK provenance and offers are brand-owned claims observed on the page, not independently verified or guaranteed to remain current.
